name: rabbitOS 3
desc: Rabbit's agentic operating system, cloud-resident, driving your devices through one agent.
desc_zh: rabbit 的智能体操作系统，跑在云端，通过一个智能体驱动你的设备。
solves: Tasks split across five devices and ten accounts need you as the router; state an outcome and OS3 decides where the work runs.
solves_zh: 任务散在五台设备和十个账号里，得你当路由器；说出想要的结果，OS3 决定活儿在哪儿跑。
best_for: You want the same request to pull a file from your laptop and a photo from your phone without wiring them together.
best_for_zh: 想让同一个请求同时从笔记本取文件、从手机拿照片，又不想自己把它们接起来时。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — rabbit.tech blog and newsroom directories）。 Missing from the ledger; the rabbit-inc vendor has only Rabbit R1. OS3 is cloud-resident with a local rabbit agent installed by a single command, one account for up to five devices, a single chat interface as the primary entry point, and universal skills compatibility. rabbit.tech/os3 redirects to the site root, so the homepage is the product site. Entry page is /try-os3, which forwards to the OS3 sign-up on os3.rabbit.tech. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：OS3 跑在云端，用户只是在本机装一个代理程序连上去，不是自己部署的系统。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.rabbit.tech/newsroom/rabbitos-3-launch 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://os3.rabbit.tech/sign-up?returnTo=%2F）。
